spec.description:
HardieFire Insulation is a specialized
high-density mineral wool insulation batt designed specifically for fire
protection in James Hardie HardieSmart wall systems, including Boundary Wall,
ZeroLot, Blade, and Aged Care systems. Composed of over 95% rock wool fibers
with cured binder, it delivers non-combustible fire performance, exceptional
acoustic separation, and thermal resistance within stud framing cavities. Tested
to AS 1530.4 as part of complete systems, it achieves fire resistance levels up
to 60/60/60 or 90/90/90 while maintaining a slim wall profile.
features: Specifically designed for use in HardieSmart fire-rated wall systems

Non-combustible
fire protection complying with AS 1530.4

Delivers thermal performance: R1.7
(60mm) and R2.5 (85mm)

Improves wall acoustic isolation and reduces airborne
sound transfer (Rw 47 to 50+)

Installed with a required 5mm compression in
stud bays to eliminate gaps

Suitable for bushfire construction up to BAL-FZ
(Flame Zone)

Lightweight and easy to cut with a mechanical hand saw or
reciprocating saw

Resistant to high temperatures, shrinking, and melting
under fire exposure

Backed by a 10-year manufacturing warranty when used with
HardieSmart systems

install:
Store
HardieFire insulation in an internal dry area protected from weather and
moisture prior to installation

Frame wall with timber or steel studs at 450mm
or 600mm centers

Cut batts outdoors or in ventilated areas using a mechanical
hand saw or reciprocating saw

Add 5mm to measured dimensions when cutting to
maintain the mandatory 5mm compression

Friction-fit batts firmly into stud
bays ensuring minimum 5mm compression vertically and horizontally

Ensure
there are no gaps, folds, or voids at junctions, corners, or behind noggings
Wear protective glasses, gloves, and P1/P2 dust mask during handling
selection_checklist:
Confirm HardieSmart wall system specification
(Boundary Wall, ZeroLot, Blade, or Aged Care system)

Select batt thickness (60mm for R1.7 /
FRL 60/60/60; 85mm for R2.5)

Select width (420mm for 450mm stud
centers; 560mm for 600mm stud centers)

Calculate pack quantities allowing
for 5mm compression
limitations:
Must not be exposed to weather or installed
while wet; not designed for prolonged exterior exposure

Must be installed
with 5mm compression in both directions to maintain certified FRL

Must be
used as part of complete HardieSmart tested systems to achieve warranty and
certified fire ratings

retrieval.rag_summary:
HardieFire Insulation is an 80 kg/m³ high-density mineral wool (rockwool) batt
manufactured by James Hardie for HardieSmart fire-rated boundary, zero-lot, and
inter-tenancy wall systems. Formed from over 95% molten rock wool with cured
binders, it is non-combustible to AS 1530.4 and achieves certified FRLs up
to 60/60/60 and BAL-FZ bushfire resistance when installed with a mandatory 5mm
compression. Available in 60mm (R1.7) and 85mm (R2.5) thicknesses to fit 450mm
and 600mm stud centers, it provides combined passive fire containment, thermal
control, and acoustic isolation.
